name: Grimhalo
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near towering mountain ranges.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
For traders, carbon and dark crystals alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
